h1

kw.msg:
10.3.0.11$ show ipv6 route isis
Codes: K - kernel route, C - connected, L - local, S - static,
       R - RIPng, O - OSPFv3, I - IS-IS, B - BGP, N - NHRP,
       T - Table, v - VNC, V - VNC-Direct, A - Babel, F - PBR,
       f - OpenFabric, t - Table-Direct,
       > - selected route, * - FIB route, q - queued, r - rejected, b - backup

test.doc: dc1 -> dc3: pe1 encapsulates towards pe3's locator, the packet transits p2 (its interface to pe3), and the reply comes back the same way towards pe1's locator.

test.name: The tenant traffic is invisible to the P routers as IPv4: P routers carry no VRF and no IPv4 tenant routes

suite.doc: The point of it all: every host reaches every other host across the SRv6 core, the traffic really crosses the P routers as SRv6-encapsulated IPv6, and the return path works for forwarded packets.
